notes.scheduling: Pulse runs are scheduled weekly per lane, staggered across the week (Mon/Tue/Wed) to smooth budget consumption and prevent Tuesday budget overruns.
notes.actor_selection: Each lane specifies preferred actors for its monitoring targets. Selection respects pay_per_event cost model and $0.25-0.50 per-run ceiling.
notes.pulse_vs_listen: Pulse = recurring, scheduled, weekly. SocialListen = on-demand, ad-hoc, immediate. Both use the same Apify wrapper and budget ledger.
notes.transcript_enrichment: Transcript actors (sc-youtube-transcripts, sc-tiktok-transcripts) available but NOT in default pulse lanes (they're higher-cost). Enabled on-demand via /social-listen --transcripts.
notes.client_lanes: Client/prospect monitoring only enabled on-demand during active engagements. Template provided; populate with client query + actor selection.
notes.budget_allocation: Each lane allocated a sub-quota within $5/mo pulse budget. If pulse_budget_allocation exceeds remaining pulse budget, that run skips gracefully (returns pulse_skipped status, no failure, no retry).
